title: Agent evals runner
description: Runs every scenario of a suite through an AI agent, judges the results and returns a Langfuse results link per model. Defaults run the whole suite named in datasetName; filter by subject or owner for a quick check.

datasetName.title: Suite (Langfuse dataset)
datasetName.description: Name of the Langfuse dataset holding the scenarios. Scenarios are authored in the repo under scenarios/<suite>/ and synced.

model.title: Model
model.description: OpenRouter model id the agent runs on, through the Apify proxy (no API key needed). Any id OpenRouter serves works, including moving aliases such as ~anthropic/claude-haiku-latest or ~openai/gpt-luna-latest; the concrete model behind an alias is recorded on the experiment as resolvedModel. The harness override selects Claude Code (default) or Codex.

subjects.title: Only these subjects
subjects.description: Subject ids, or just the last part. In the Store suite that is an Actor: compass/crawler-google-places or crawler-google-places. Empty = every scenario in the suite. A filtered run never writes run-level scores or the report.

scenarioIds.title: Only these scenarios (optional)
scenarioIds.description: Scenario ids (dataset item ids, e.g. google-search-scraper-usage-german-serp) to run. Combines with the other filters.

owners.title: Only these owners
owners.description: Owner names as in the scenario folders. In the Store suite these are the teams: google, socials, video, universe.

repeats.title: Repeats per scenario
repeats.description: Run each scenario this many times. Use 3 when checking whether a change to your subject helped; a single run can flip on a flaky scrape. The judge writes pass@N and consistency per scenario.

judge.title: Judge the results
judge.description: Start the Judge Actor when the agents finish so the results link already shows verdicts and fix areas. Turn off only to re-judge later with a different judge model.

surfaces.title: Surfaces (optional)
surfaces.description: How the agent reaches Apify, one experiment per entry so the compare view shows them side by side: mcp (Apify MCP server, the default), cli (Apify CLI in Bash), api (raw HTTP to the Apify API). Each name is a file surfaces/<name>.yaml. Combines with skill sets: surfaces x skill sets x models.

cliVersion.title: Apify CLI version (optional)
cliVersion.description: Test another Apify CLI build on every CLI surface in this run, e.g. beta or 1.10.1-beta.37. Empty = the version pinned in the surface file.

skillSets.title: Skill sets (optional)
skillSets.description: Agent skills to inject, one experiment per entry so the compare view shows which skills help. Each entry is 'none' or skill names joined with '+', e.g. none, notion-research-documentation, notion-knowledge-capture+notion-research-documentation. Skills come from apify/agent-skills at a pinned commit (or Skills from GitHub); the suite profile lists which apply (agentSkills). Empty = one run without skills.

mcpcVersion.title: mcpc version (optional)
mcpcVersion.description: Test another mcpc build on every surface that installs it (the cli surface), e.g. beta or 0.7.0-beta.2. Empty = the version pinned in the surface file.

skillsRef.title: Skills from GitHub (optional)
skillsRef.description: Take the skills from a public GitHub ref instead of the pinned apify/agent-skills commit, to test a skill change before it is merged: owner/repo#ref or owner/repo#ref:path (path defaults to skills), e.g. apify/agent-skills#my-branch. The run records the resolved commit.

skillCombinations.title: Every skill combination
skillCombinations.description: Run every subset of the skills (from Skill sets, or the suite's agentSkills when empty), including 'none'. Four skills = 16 experiments; filter scenarios first.

models.title: Model matrix (optional)
models.description: Run the same scenarios on several models, one experiment per model, sequentially. Overrides Model when set. An entry is a model id, or {"model": "...", "harness": "codex"} to run that model on Codex instead of Claude Code. OpenAI models must use Codex. Each id is preflighted and resolved before any session starts.
models.sectionDescription: Defaults are right for the daily run and for checking your own Actor.

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: Model that grades the agent runs, pinned id or moving alias (~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest). The judge resolves an alias once per batch and stamps the concrete model into every score. Keep it fixed across runs you want to compare.

concurrency.title: Parallel agent sessions
concurrency.description: Sessions running at once inside this Actor run. 4 per 4 GB of memory is safe; 16 fits in 8 GB.

perItemTimeoutSecs.title: Per-scenario timeout (seconds)
perItemTimeoutSecs.description: A session past this is killed; the scenario becomes inconclusive (infrastructure), not a failure. A scenario's own timeoutSecs overrides this.

itemLimit.title: Scenario limit (0 = all)
itemLimit.description: Cap the number of scenarios after filtering. Handy for smoke tests.

healthThreshold.title: Health threshold
healthThreshold.description: Share of sessions that must complete for the run to count as healthy (exit code 0). Below it the run fails with exit code 10 so schedule alerts fire. Decimal between 0 and 1.

categories.title: Category filter (deprecated)
categories.description: Older alias of "Only these subjects" matching the scenario's category slug.

mcpUrl.title: MCP server URL
mcpUrl.description: Apify MCP server used by suites whose profile names no other server. Each scenario narrows it with ?tools=.
mcpUrl.sectionDescription: Deployment plumbing. Teams never need this section.

useOpenRouterProxy.title: LLM via Apify OpenRouter proxy
useOpenRouterProxy.description: On the platform this is the only option. Turn off only for local runs with your own Claude login.

skipPreflight.title: Skip preflight
skipPreflight.description: Skip the MCP tools/list and LLM proxy check that fails a broken environment in seconds.

maxSessions.title: Session limit
maxSessions.description: Refuse to start (exit 15) when models x surfaces x skill sets x scenarios x repeats is larger than this. Filter scenarios or raise the limit on purpose.

mcpEnv.title: MCP server environment (JSON)
mcpEnv.description: Values for ${VAR} placeholders in the suite's MCP server config (e.g. {"NOTION_TOKEN": "ntn_..."}). Overrides the Actor environment. Not encrypted: prefer Actor environment variables for real runs.

trigger.title: Trigger label
trigger.description: Shown in the run name. Defaults to the platform origin (schedule, web, api, cli).

notify.title: Post Slack digest
notify.description: Post the per-team digest to Slack after this run (needs SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL or SLACK_WEBHOOKS_BY_OWNER in the Actor environment). Leave unset to post on scheduled runs only.

harness.title: Harness override (JSON)
harness.description: {kind, model, maxTurns}. kind selects claude-code (default) or codex. Example: {"kind":"codex","model":"openai/gpt-5-mini","maxTurns":12}. Codex uses MCP only, disables shell tools, and stops after maxTurns completed tool-call rounds; scenario metadata.maxTurns takes precedence.

artifactStore.title: Eval artifacts store
artifactStore.description: Named key-value store for full agent logs, evidence snapshots and tool-schema snapshots. Leave empty to use the store from the Actor environment (ARTIFACT_STORE_ID).

langfuseBaseUrl.title: Langfuse base URL override
langfuseBaseUrl.description: Langfuse base URL. Defaults to the Actor's environment (https://langfuse.apify.dev).

langfusePublicKey.title: Langfuse public key
langfusePublicKey.description: Key of the Langfuse project the suite lives in. Pass it on every run; it is forwarded to the judge. Without it the Actor's own environment keys are used.

langfuseSecretKey.title: Langfuse secret key
langfuseSecretKey.description: Key of the Langfuse project the suite lives in. Pass it on every run; it is forwarded to the judge. Without it the Actor's own environment keys are used.
